start.question: What is the printer doing?
start.note: Two different branches below end at the same shared fix.

queued.question: Is there a job stuck at the top of the print queue?

offline.question: Does Windows list the printer as online in Printers & scanners?

options.label: Yes, but jobs still don't print
No, it says offline
options.resolution: Power cycle the printer, check its network cable or Wi-Fi, then remove and re-add it.

driver.question: Did this start after a recent Windows or driver update?

options.label: No
options.resolution: Run a head cleaning from the printer's own menu, then print a test page.

restart_spooler.text: Restart the Print Spooler service, clear the spool folder, then print a test page.

reinstall_driver.text: Remove the printer, delete its driver in Print Server Properties, then reinstall the current driver.

kb_printer_basics.title: Printer troubleshooting basics
kb_printer_basics.body: Check power, cabling or Wi-Fi, paper and toner first. Print a test page from the printer's own menu to separate hardware from Windows.

kb_spooler.title: Restarting the Print Spooler
kb_spooler.body: Open services.msc, restart Print Spooler, and clear the files in the spool folder first if a job is stuck.

kb_driver.title: Reinstalling a printer driver
kb_driver.body: Remove the device, open Print Server Properties, delete the driver package, then install the current driver.
